reporting-org.narrative: Harvard Global Research and Support Services, Inc.

title.narrative: Building on “What Works” for Improving Education Quality in Pakistan using a Systems Model

description.narrative: Throughout the inception period of this grant, HG will support the inception activities for all three studies. Main Study 1: Targeted Instruction and the Take-Up and Diffusion of Innovation - support government engagement in Pakistan, contribute to the research design, and advise on any preliminary field activities. Main Study 2: Accountability Gaps: Experimental Evidence on Improving Public Service Delivery - lead the final research design, advise on field activities including data collection, and support any research/academic paper writing that may emerge from Main Study 3: Linking Foundational Learning, Long-Term Outcomes, and Policymaker Preferences using LEAPS Longitudinal Data during the inception period.
